description.en: Uintatherium anceps: whole-organism living environment prop. Nominal 1m length; skin, colour, flesh, ears, toes and tail are conservative art. YPM VP011036 skull and historical whole reconstruction with museum genus mount are references, not copied scan. Three pairs blunt bosses and paired upper canines; no sex assignment.
description.zh: Uintatherium风格化完整活体环境道具；软组织、姿态、颜色与名义尺度含艺术解释，并非精确标本。
